Combat Ratings

	Your combat rating is based on the number of kills you have made, which is the sum of the crew complements of all the ships you have destroyed. The scale is as follows:

Kills			Rating
0			Harmless
1			Mostly Harmless
100			Fair
200			Average
400			Above Average
800			Competent
1,600		Noteworthy
3,200		Excellent
6,400		Dangerous
12,800		Deadly
25,600		Ultimate
